userVisible: The module builds into one executable JavaScript file with no runtime package installation.
Selfcheck creates and checks the database and reports its runtime, checksum, schema and integrity.
Command discovery lists every command and whether it reads input or writes data.
A program persists with a history sequence and content hash.
A control belongs to its program and records a history receipt.
Recorded evidence supports a control only from its collection time until its expiration.
check: node --test --test-name-pattern='evidence and attestations change|generated clocks never count' test/cli.test.ts test/domain.test.ts

check: node --test --test-name-pattern='evidence and attestations change|generated clocks never count' test/cli.test.ts test/domain.test.ts

userVisible: Status reports red without current support, yellow near expiration and green with longer support.
check: node --test --test-name-pattern='evidence and attestations change|renewal threshold yellow' test/cli.test.ts test/domain.test.ts

userVisible: Gaps lists controls without current evidence, including controls supported only by an attestation.
Expiring returns evidence and attestations within the requested horizon and suggests task inputs without creating tasks.
A document revision records its Page identifier, version and hash while retaining earlier history.
A mismatched document hash returns E_DOC_CHANGED and leaves the recorded document unchanged.
Export returns the program records, complete history and a chain head that can be checked independently.
Chain verification checks the database or a piped export and reports the first changed history row.
check: node --test --test-name-pattern='exported history verifies|raw-file edit reports' test/cli.test.ts test/storage.test.ts

userVisible: Rebuild restores current records from history without changing that history.

userVisible: History remains append-only across repeated records, revisions, rejected SQL changes and concurrent writers.
Every analysis command repeats the same answer for fixed time and seed and leaves stored data unchanged.
check: node --test --test-name-pattern='analysis returns identical|analysis needs a current' test/cli.test.ts

userVisible: Invalid input is rejected before creation and JSON input files behave like stdin.
Suggested tasks use the documented add fields and stable keys; release acceptance is checked when the tasks release exists.
The CLI follows the shared envelope, exit-code, determinism, private-path refusal and read-only rules.
Repository files are understandable without private planning documents or machine-specific paths.
The two-writer history model preserves committed rows, projections and chain links, and broken variants fail.
